product: Merchant cash loan with daily EDI
collection_method: Daily eNACH auto-debit on the merchant's bank account at 07:00 (not netted from settlements)

kfs.bounce_charges: Nil (waived for first-attempt friction cases under hardship policy)

clauses.4.1: EDI of ₹500 is collected daily by eNACH; a bounced EDI may be paid the same day via a UPI link without penalty.
clauses.4.2: EDI holiday: on documented cash-flow stress the borrower may pause EDIs for up to 2 consecutive days, with explicit consent, at most once per 30 days. Paused EDIs move to the end of the tenure; no penalty interest.
clauses.4.3: Hardship assessment uses settlement history shared with consent via the RBI Account Aggregator framework.
